title: Big Gus | KEY.co
meta_description: Seacrest Beach access directly across the street
description_expanded: Perfect Beach Getaway! Big Gus is absolutely amazing! The house is huge, spotless, and beautifully designed with everything you could ever want – private pool, golf cart, game room, bikes, and just steps to the beach. The ocean views from the balconies are stunning, and the kitchen is a chef’s dream. Bedrooms are spacious and comfortable, with plenty of room for our whole group. The location is unbeatable – close to Alys Beach, Seacrest, and The Big Chill. Hands down the best vacation rental we’ve ever stayed in. Can’t wait to come back! The home is well equipped with linens on each bed, as well as an extra set for any sleeper sofas that may be in the home. Each bathroom is stocked appropriately with bath towels, hand towels, wash cloths, and bath mats to accommodate the sleeping capacity of the home. There are starter sets of soap, detergent, dish soap, and toilet paper there for your convenience. Kitchens are each stocked with enough dishes, serving pieces, glassware, and all the other kitchen necessities to prepare meals during the guests' stay.
